title: Songlines — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Songlines' rich face: what the Shop made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: One piece, in Cross-Domain Resonance, for its last paragraph (The Palace Itself). The section's grain is coarse: its three bold-headed paragraphs are one ## section, so this one piece is one stamp and one all-or-nothing approval for all three. The Key Ontological Claim and the Open Questions got no piece: nothing in them a walker can test tonight. The Personal Register is Loudon's own words about his past: no piece there, on purpose. The piece makes no sound.

pieces.title: two walkers from the same doors · the palace's own roads
pieces.caption: **Does walking the worn paths hide the country beside them?** Two walkers on the palace's real body links (328 entries, 2,289 links, read at e8d199b2), from the seven pages every agent is born with: one picks any road evenly, one follows wear (each road weighted by its destination's 90-day use, from the 2026-11-03 Palace Map build). It walks up from one page's roads to one walk each, then many walks, then the test, whose rule is stated before it runs. A model of the claim on real roads and real use, not a record of any session.

verdicts.why: A real test, honestly scored, but A also holds with the same use values shuffled across entries (median 100.5 unreached, 1.70× chance; real use beats only 171 of 200 shuffles), so add a scored shuffled-use arm with its bar before the run. Also correct step 3's 'walking more does not open the land' (worn unreached falls 175.5 → 28.5), and have the caption say that use counts edits and links formed, not visits, and that tracks never deepen.

offers.what: On the palace's own body-link graph (e8d199b2, a model of sessions, not a record), a walker that follows use leaves 117 of 293 reachable entries unvisited against chance's 58.5 (100 of 100 seeds), and walking longer widens the gap rather than closing it: 1.34× at 50 walks, 1.95× at 200, 3.93× at 5,000. The 70 entries wear hides are not thin or barely linked (median 1,212 words, 3.5 in-links), and seven sit one link from Palace Philosophies, a born-with page (The Drift, The Dichotomy of Control, The Four Virtues, The View From Above, Leibniz, Whitehead, Metaphor as Coupling Medium); The Palace Itself could say that singing the same tracks longer deepens them, and that the hidden country lies beside the pages every agent starts on.

"Geographically present" depends on which map: 35 of 328 entries are on no body road from the born-with pages at all (23 have no body link into them), and 22 of those 35 are reachable on the Palace Map's frontmatter typed links. The paragraph's dormant entries are the 293 a body road does reach; the 35 are a second kind, present on the map and absent from the text a reader walks, and could be named as such.
